item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 12/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong gradually today. It will be cloudier over the region in the following couple of days. A cold front is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Saturday. Temperatures will fall appreciably with a few rain patches over the region. The associated intense northeast monsoon will bring dry and rather cool weather to the coastal areas of Guangdong early next week.

Date/Month: 12/12 (Tuesday)
Wind: Light winds force 2, becoming east to northeast force 4, force 5 offshore later.
Weather: Cloudy periods with one or two light rain patches and relatively low visibility in some areas in the morning and at night. Mainly fine during the day.
Temp range: 22 - 28 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 13/12 (Wednesday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 22 - 25 C
R.H. range: 75 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
